name: alloy2d
description: Alloy2D: The Alloy of React & Pixi.js for Cross-Platform Mini-Games (Web / 微信小游戏 / Electron)

scripts.test: npm --workspace=alloy2d run test && npm --workspace=@alloy2d/suika-game run test
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=alloy2d run typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p games/star-match3 && tsc --noEmit -p games/yang-sheep && tsc --noEmit -p games/suika-game
scripts.build:game: npm --workspace=@alloy2d/star-match3 run build && npm --workspace=@alloy2d/yang-sheep run build && npm --workspace=@alloy2d/suika-game run build
scripts.build:wx: npm --workspace=@alloy2d/star-match3 run build:wx && npm --workspace=@alloy2d/yang-sheep run build:wx && npm --workspace=@alloy2d/suika-game run build:wx
scripts.build: npm run build:engine && npm run build:game && npm run build:wx
